name: bg-kaleidoscope
title: Kaleidoscope Background — rotating flower ring of one photo
description: Seamless looping background: one image multiplied into a flower — a full-size center copy plus a ring of petal copies (alternating mirror) rotating together, with synchronized breathing scale. A dimmed counter-rotating copy of the same image backs the flower so the frame is always fully covered. Every copy stays recognizable. 12s loop, cut anywhere. Landscape 16:9 twin of bg-kaleidoscope-portrait (geometry recomputed from the canvas diagonal).

variables.label: Image
variables.description: Source image multiplied into the flower ring (URL or project asset path)

variables.label: Segments
variables.description: Petals around the center (4-16, even numbers look most symmetric)

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Full ring turns per 12s loop (integer, keeps the loop seamless) (1-3)

variables.label: Breathe
variables.description: Breathing scale amplitude 0-1 (0 = pure rotation); peak +8%

variables.label: Center scale
variables.description: Center image size relative to its auto-computed base (0.6-1.6)

variables.label: Scrim
variables.description: Black overlay strength for text readability 0-1
